digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend architecture and ADR documentation
propositions: ADR 0055 must record the jira_family layer structure, two parameterizing contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel), and the shared-jira provenance decision deferring generalization to epic be74.

The backend contract suite certifies a backend only conditionally: the TicketTransport port is incomplete and untyped, declaring six members while the core accesses twenty-one distinct members, with twelve absent from the DC adapter, causing silent failures during write passes.
RemoteRef.instance is never constructed in production code and exists only as test helpers; the ADR must present it as intended design with a tracked gap, not as existing reality.

The Jira-family seam architecture converged with mature Jira integrations (maintained client library, PAT bearer auth, containerized verification), with operational gaps (index lag, pagination, rate limits) appearing only against differently-configured instances.
Data Center reaches read-only on 28 March 2029, making this a deliberately time-boxed investment for self-hosted clients, with the durable asset being the family seam rather than the DC adapter.

User documentation must specify least-privilege DC requirements (dedicated service account with scoped PAT), cleartext-only allow_insecure for loopback testing, ca_bundle for internal CAs, and resolved_statuses for non-standard workflows.
